title: Inbound Limit Uplift for Inbound-Shortage Cases by Days Open (FBN)
content:
For a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) inbound-shortage case, the inbound limit uplift is the long-wait inbound uplift of 10 units for a case opened at least the long inbound wait of 30 days before the handling date, the short-wait inbound uplift of 5 units for a case opened at least the short inbound wait of 14 days but fewer than 30 days before it, and no uplift for a newer case.

The days are counted from the moment the inbound-shortage case was opened to the handling date.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical case ages)**

| Days open | Uplift |
|---|---|
| 10 | none |
| 13 | none |
| 14 | 5 units |
| 29 | 5 units |
| 30 | 10 units |
| 61 | 10 units |
